headline: 英倫文化界兩訃聞
context: 英國衛報刊出兩則訃聞。女高音吉兒・戈梅茲（Jill Gomez）享壽83歲，以清亮唱腔與舞台魅力聞名，曾在葛萊伯恩（Glyndebourne）與皇家歌劇院演出多部經典歌劇。導演約翰・厄文（John Irvin）享壽86歲，代表作是改編自約翰・勒卡雷小說的《鍋匠、裁縫、士兵、間諜》。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Soprano with razor-sharp articulation who created lead roles including the Duchess of Argyll in Powder Her Face A lustrous vocal quality, combined with an alluring, exuberant stage presence, ensured the popularity of the soprano Jill Gomez, who has died aged 83, on both operatic stage and concert platform. When her talent came to the fore in the early 1970s she was hailed by Arthur Jacobs in Opera magazine, along with Josephine Barstow, as “the most exciting of our newer female singers”, while reviews of the time hailed her Governess in Britten’s The Turn of the Screw and Anne Trulove in Stravinsky’s The Rake’s Progress as among the finest. The latter role was one of those she took, along with Mélisande, Calisto and Helena (A Midsummer Night’s Dream), at Glyndebourne, where Gomez enjoyed her first major successes, appearing between 1969 and 1984. At Covent Garden her roles included Lisa in La Sonnambula, Titania in A Midsummer Night’s Dream and Lauretta in Puccini’s Gianni Schicchi. Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: British film-maker and director of Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy who was described by Alec Guinness as having ‘balls behind the camera’ Bouncing from war zone reportage to cold war espionage, Hollywood horror to Sherwood Forest swashbuckler, Harold Pinter to Arnold Schwarzenegger, the director John Irvin, who has died aged 86, was nothing if not eclectic. “I’m a bit split,” he said. “I like playing with expensive toys, yet I also like the miniatures. I hate being pigeonholed, and I like to do the unexpected.” Continue reading...

導演約翰・厄文過世，享壽86歲，代表作為《鍋匠、裁縫、士兵、間諜》。

thread_text: 英國衛報刊出兩則訃聞。女高音吉兒・戈梅茲（Jill Gomez）過世，享壽83歲，1970年代初以清亮唱腔與舞台魅力走紅，曾在葛萊伯恩（Glyndebourne）與皇家歌劇院演出多部經典歌劇角色。導演約翰・厄文（John Irvin）也過世了，享壽86歲，代表作是改編自約翰・勒卡雷小說的《鍋匠、裁縫、士兵、間諜》，演員亞歷・堅尼斯曾形容他「鏡頭後很有種」。
threads_text: 英國衛報刊出兩則訃聞。女高音吉兒・戈梅茲（Jill Gomez）過世，享壽83歲，1970年代初以清亮唱腔與舞台魅力走紅，曾被樂評形容是當代最令人興奮的新生代女歌手之一，在葛萊伯恩（Glyndebourne）與皇家歌劇院都演過多部經典歌劇角色。導演約翰・厄文（John Irvin）也過世了，享壽86歲，作品橫跨戰地報導片、冷戰諜報片到好萊塢恐怖片，代表作是改編自約翰・勒卡雷小說的《鍋匠、裁縫、士兵、間諜》，演員亞歷・堅尼斯曾形容他「鏡頭後很有種」。
voice_text: 這次要說兩位過世的英國文化界人士。女高音吉兒・戈梅茲，享壽83歲，1970年代初就以清亮的唱腔跟舞台魅力走紅，在葛萊伯恩跟皇家歌劇院演過不少經典角色。另一位是導演約翰・厄文，享壽86歲，他最有名的作品，是改編自約翰・勒卡雷小說的《鍋匠、裁縫、士兵、間諜》。
